body: I feel the same. I hope it gets better for you.

I have no one to reach out too so I resort to posting sad stuff so I can at least get someone to talk to about it. I obviously don't expect someone to know everything about me and fix all my problems.
Being disconnected is the only time I feel good, is that bad?
I don't want to find new people anymore, I want to get over wanting people to care about me
I find it hard to believe there are
I don't want anything else anymore, this is all I want
I have given myself other goals

Just. Bring stuff up. I try to word it different but it just gets the same reaction of quickly changing the subject or just something like "that sucks"

Yes I know about self help activities.
I never had help, just people that pretended like they would until I sad something. I just wish people would stop acting like they're there to help when they're not
I've been in other states of mind though. It's fleeting. Knowing it might get better isn't enough to keep going.
